title: Design: QB Unexported lists a rejected close entry under Journal Entries
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Use a location that is connected to QuickBooks Online, with every ShopView Accounts row mapped.
  • Have a customer flagged as Internal customer, with one asset, and its default internal category left at General Internal.
  • Have an internal work order closed with a posting date in a QuickBooks closed period, made for this test.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow5-01-01-qb-unexported-held-entry.png, iwo-happy-41-40-quickbooks-held-entry.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open QB Unexported.
  2. Click the Journal Entries tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • QB Unexported opens.

Step 2:

  • The entry is listed with the QuickBooks error text, the work order number and the type "Internal Work Order Close", with Export and Mark as Exported.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11764 (Story 7, QuickBooks Online sync)

  • S7-N3: “If the posting date falls in a closed period, QuickBooks rejects the entry and it lands in QB Unexported under Journal Entries with the QuickBooks error text, the work order number and the classification (type "Internal Work Order Close", "Internal Work Order Reopen" or "No Charge line"), with Export and Mark as Exported as for other rows.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: pages "Flow 5 · What the books see" / "Happy flow v6", boards "01 QB Unexported · held entry" (Flow 5 · What the books see), "40 QuickBooks · held entry" (Happy flow v6).
